messages.author: 674305bdd88beadd
messages.subject: binwidth does not work here.. ?
parts:
Dear all, 

i am plotting autocorrelations with ggplot2 (bins).  In general it does work, but somehow

qplot(lag,value,data=r,geom="bar",stat="identity",position="identity",ylab="acf") + facet_grid(variable~.) +geom_hline(yintercept=calc_ci(ci=ci,n=dim(r)[1]),color="blue",size=0.1) +geom_hline(yintercept=calc_ci(ci=ci,n=dim(r)[1])*(-1),color="blue",size=0.1) +geom_hline(yintercept=0,color="red",alpha=0.9,size=0.2)


ci is a custom function here, so if you are trying to reproduce it, please leave it out - i just posted it to make sure it has nothing to do with my problem. Anyway the following should be the relevant code:

qplot(lag,value,data=r,geom="bar",stat="identity",position="identity",ylab="acf") + facet_grid(variable~.)

unfortunately binwidth does not seem to affect my plot in any way. When i have a long series of lags, i´d like to see smaller bins. 

Thanks for any suggestions and ideas !

best regards

matt

parts:
Hi Hadley, 

of course, just use any autocorrelation data, e.g.:
the function is just a simple hack to deal with the acf class and melt() here. 
the ci function within the qplot is not important, just insert 0.3 for example. 

best regards, thx in advance for any help

matt



ret_acf =function(x){
a=acf(x,plot=FALSE,lag.max=length(x))
return(a$acf)
}

e=rnorm(50)
f=ret_acf(e)
r=as.data.frame(cbind(1:length(e),e))
names(r)[1]="lag"
r=melt(r,id="lag")
